card.title: Paper Planes Home
card.lyrics:
[verse]
We folded maps into paper planes
Threw them off the roof in the summer rain
Nothing landed where we said it would
[chorus]
And I would do it all again
Every wrong turn every friend
Nothing landed where we said
And it was good it was good
card.note: Vocal named once and not described further - measured recipe: naming takes intelligibility 10%% -> 90%%, describing the mix drops it to 30%%.
